note: The images the owner pushes to the project registry before the catalog task is enabled. Push each by digest into the repository named here, with the same platform for all four, then put the four digests in the jobs variable openmetadata_images. The tracked file names no release and no digest: the owner chooses the release and records the digest in the variable file, which stays out of Git. Every upstream name below is unverified.
platform: linux/amd64 until the Arm check passes for all four images, then linux/arm64 together with openmetadata_cpu_architecture = ARM64
arm64_check: docker buildx imagetools inspect <upstream>:<release> lists linux/arm64 for each of the four images
